values.note: $29 per site in 2026, and the same in recreation.gov's 2027 table. Two vehicles or one RV included; $11 for a third vehicle (boat/ATV trailers count as one). Walk-up fees by cash, check or money order in the fee tube.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/father-dyer-campground ('$29 fee per site for overnight camping. Two vehicles or one RV is included in the camping fee. $11 fee for a third vehicle'; last updated July 31, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232044/rates (2026 and 2027 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 29), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Forest Service: 'May to September', weather dependent. Dates are recreation.gov's 2026 fee season (May 22 - Sept 6).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/father-dyer-campground ('Seasons of Use: May to September. Opening and closing dates are weather dependent') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232044/rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 09-06), read 2026-10-26

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232044 (notice 'No hookups are available') + campsite catalog for 232044 (all sites NONELECTRIC), read 2026-10-26

values.note: The FS and recreation.gov say 26 sites; the catalog lists 23 public sites (plus 4 management sites). Catalog lengths 20-35 ft (eleven at 30, three at 35); four pull-throughs. Gravel or dirt spurs. One RV and two tents per site.

sites.source: campsite catalog for 232044 (site types, reservable flag, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/father-dyer-campground ('Father Dyer Campground has 26 sites'; 'one recreational vehicle (RV) and two tents are allowed per site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232044 ('Parking spurs are gravel or dirt'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: No water in 2026 (bring your own, including for campfires); the campground otherwise has potable water. The White Star and Printer Boy dump stations are closed for the season. Firewood from the host.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232044 (notice 'Water will NOT be available in this campground in 2026 ... the RV Dump Stations at White Star and Printer Boy will remain closed this season'; 'Firewood is available for purchase from the Host') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/father-dyer-campground ('Vault toilets are available throughout the campground', 'Potable water is not available at this site'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: Reservable on recreation.gov (or 877-444-6777) at least four days ahead for the 2026 season May 22 - Sept 6 (2027: May 21 - Sept 5); all 23 public sites are reservable in the catalog. 14 nights in a rolling 60 days. The FS page states a weekend 2-night and holiday 3-night minimum (walk-ups exempt), but recreation.gov's rules for this facility list none.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232044 (facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 14 'Rolling 60 Days', reservationCutOff 4; no minimum-stay rule) + /rates (2026, 2027 Peak Season) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/father-dyer-campground ('Call 877-444-6777 or visit recreation.gov at least four days in advance. A minimum stay on Friday and Saturday night is required on weekends. A three-night minimum stay is required on holiday weekends. Walk-ups are exempt'), read 2026-10-26

values.note: 50% off the site the pass holder occupies (concessionaire-run sites).

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/father-dyer-campground ('The Interagency Senior Pass and the Interagency Access Pass qualify for a 50% discount at concessionaire-run campsites'), read 2026-10-26

note: Shaded lodgepole and fir forest near the east shore of Turquoise Lake at 9,900 ft, about 3 mi west of Leadville via CR 4 and CR 9C (Leadville RD, Pike-San Isabel NF); a foot trail to the lake runs between sites 16 and 17. Moderate use on weekdays, heavy on weekends. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $29 (2026, 2027), no hookups, 23 public sites to 35 ft (catalog), reservable on recreation.gov. Added season 05-22 to 09-06 (FS 'May to September' + rec.gov fee season), reservable season, 4-day cutoff, 14-night limit, pull-throughs, vault toilets, no water and no dump in 2026, senior/access 50%. Min-stay not recorded: FS page states 2/3-night minimums but rec.gov's rules have none (flagged). Note: dropped 'Twin Lakes' (wrong: it is Turquoise Lake), '~35 ft' and field repeats.
flags: Road alert: PSICC 'Turquoise Lake Road (County Road 4) Closure' (alert start April 7, 2026): CR 4 'is barricaded from the Abe Lee parking turnoff to Hagerman Pass. Access to Turquoise Lake is still available via County Road 9C and County Road 9'. Father Dyer is reached from Leadville on CR 4 then CR 9C (recreation.gov directions), so it stays reachable.

Minimum stay conflict: the FS page says weekends need a Friday+Saturday stay and holiday weekends three nights (walk-ups exempt), but recreation.gov's facility rules for 232044 carry no minimum (only 14-night maximum, 4-day cutoff). Not recorded; Collegiate Peaks (same boilerplate) does have the rules on recreation.gov.

Water claim lead: recreation.gov says the campground 'is situated on the eastern shore of Turquoise Lake' (FS: 'near the eastern shore', with a foot trail to the lake between sites 16 and 17); the entry is 'not waterfront'. Worth a waterfront re-audit.

Entry phone is empty. Leadville Ranger District 719-486-0749 (FS page contact and recreation.gov 'information only'); recreation.gov also gives (661) 702-1420 'for facility specific information' (concessionaire line, not named).
Agency page for the website if wanted: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/psicc/recreation/father-dyer-campground (website is the recreation.gov listing).
